body.en: In IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL (Paper 1, Non-Calculator): (1) The general term of \( (a + b)^n \) is \( T_{r+1} = \binom{n}{r}a^{n-r}b^r \); (2) Double-angle identities \( \sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta \) and \( \cos 2\theta = 2\cos^2\theta - 1 = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta \) reduce quadratic trig equations; (3) By reverse chain rule, \( \int g'(x)[g(x)]^n\,\mathrm{d}x = \frac{[g(x)]^{n+1}}{n+1} + C \) (\( n \neq -1 \)).
body.ar: In IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL (Paper 1, Non-Calculator): (1) The general term of \( (a + b)^n \) is \( T_{r+1} = \binom{n}{r}a^{n-r}b^r \); (2) Double-angle identities \( \sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta \) and \( \cos 2\theta = 2\cos^2\theta - 1 = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta \) reduce quadratic trig equations; (3) By reverse chain rule, \( \int g'(x)[g(x)]^n\,\mathrm{d}x = \frac{[g(x)]^{n+1}}{n+1} + C \) (\( n \neq -1 \)).

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (AA SL — Binomial Theorem, Proof, Radian Trigonometry & Analytical Calculus)
label.ar: ◆ البرهان والاشتقاق الرياضي (مسار التحليل والتقاربات (AA SL) — ذات الحدين والبرهان والمثلثات والتفاضل التحليلي)

body.en: First-Principles Justification: Completing the square on \( ax^2 + bx + c \) gives \( a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \), which simultaneously establishes the vertex coordinates, discriminant condition \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac \), and quadratic root formula.
body.ar: البرهان الجبري: بإكمال المربع للمقدار \(ax^2 + bx + c\) نحصل على صيغة الرأس والمميز \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac\) بدقة تامة.

body.en:
Problem: Express \( f(x) = x^2 - 22x + 131 \) in completed-square vertex form and find its minimum value.

Solution: Halving \( -22 \) gives \( -11 \), so \( f(x) = (x - 11)^2 - 121 + 131 = (x - 11)^2 + 10 \). Minimum value is \( 10 \) at \( x = 11 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد صيغة إكمال المربع للدالة \( f(x) = x^2 - 22x + 131 \).

الحل: \( f(x) = (x - 11)^2 + 10 \) والقيمة الصغرى هي \( 10 \) عند \( x = 11 \).

body.en:
Problem: Find the value of \( k \) for which \( y = 2x + k \) is tangent to \( y = x^2 - 22x + 126 \).

Solution: Equating gives \( x^2 - 24x + (126 - k) = 0 \). Setting \( \Delta = (-24)^2 - 4(126 - k) = 0 \) yields \( k = -18 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد قيمة \( k \) التي تجعل المستقيم \( y = 2x + k \) مماساً للمنحنى \( y = x^2 - 22x + 126 \).

الحل: بوضع المميز \( \Delta = 0 \) نجد \( k = -18 \).

label.en: Worked Example 8.C — Rate of Change & Tangent Slope
label.ar: مثال محلول 8.C — معدل التغير وميل المماس

body.en:
Problem: Find the instantaneous rate of change of \( g(x) = x^3 - 33x^2 + 363x + 10 \) at \( x = 13 \).

Solution: \( g'(x) = 3(x - 11)^2 \), so \( g'(13) = 3(2)^2 = 12 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد معدل التغير اللحظي للدالة \( g(x) = x^3 - 33x^2 + 363x + 10 \) عند \( x = 13 \).

الحل: \( g'(13) = 3(2)^2 = 12 \).
